sentence_stem: We went to the shop because
full_sentence: We went to the shop because we needed bread and eggs.
acceptable_variants: we had run out of coffee.

options.text: the shop was closed on Monday.
options.why_wrong: This describes the shop but does not give a reason for going there.

options.text: we wanted to watch a film.
options.why_wrong: A shop does not show films, so this reason does not match the place we went to.

options.text: the shop was very far away.
options.why_wrong: This describes the distance to the shop, not a reason for going there.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for the action in the first part of the sentence. The correct completion gives a real reason for going to the shop, while the other options describe the shop or give an unlikely reason.
translation: Poszliśmy do sklepu, ponieważ potrzebowaliśmy chleba i jajek.
